onbehalf.title: Enter an update for someone else
onbehalf.intro: Use this when someone gives you an update by phone, WhatsApp, in a meeting or by letter, and does not enter it themselves. Choose the person, then the item.
onbehalf.none: This person has no open items.
onbehalf.not_allowed: Only programme administrators enter updates for someone else.

bulk.title: Bulk upload
bulk.intro: Use the Excel template to add or update many items at once. Fill only the sheets you need. The file is checked straight away; you can fix cells here and check again.

bulk.passed: The file passed the checks and is waiting for approval. Nothing changes on the dashboard until it is approved.
bulk.rejected: The file has not passed yet. Fix the red cells (and the amber ones if you can), then save. Or upload a corrected file.
bulk.file_rejected: The file itself could not be accepted. Fix it and upload it again.
bulk.legend: Red cells must be fixed. Amber cells lower the quality score.
bulk.ignored_note: Not used by the dashboard, so ignored: {columns}.
bulk.stat_red_context: Must be fixed before it can pass

approvals.intro: Updates waiting for your approval, grouped by who sent them, oldest first.
